question: The Birsa Munda International Hockey Stadium, the largest hockey stadium in the country, is situated in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rourkela, Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **Birsa Munda International Hockey Stadium:-**

 
 
• **It is the largest hockey stadium in the country, with a seating capacity of 15,000.**
 
• It was built in 2010 for the Men's Hockey World Cup and has since hosted several international hockey tournaments.
 
• The stadium has state-of-the-art facilities, including a synthetic turf and floodlights for night matches.
 
• The Birsa Munda International Hockey Stadium is located in Rourkela, Odisha, India.
